'''Solid-state transponders''' were conceived by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to track enemy fighters hit by [[flechette torpedo]]es. The torpedoes contained hundreds of thousands of these transponders, which adhered to targets as part of the debris fields produced as the torpedoes exploded.
